title: Remove the dead no-op catchError in OutboxPushPipeline._runValue
why: `removed` is the same Future as `ourSlot`, which is built via `.then<void>((_) {}, onError: (Object _) {})` -- the onError handler there already converts any failure into a normal completion, so ourSlot/removed can never complete with an error. The later `unawaited(removed.catchError((_) {}))` is defensive code guarding against something that cannot happen.
recommendation: Delete the no-op catchError call, or add a one-line comment if there's a reason (e.g. future-proofing against a refactor) to keep it.
acceptance_criteria: Line removed, or a comment explains why an unreachable catchError is intentionally retained.
